text.body: || śrīviśvambharopaniṣat || atha hainaṃ śāṇḍilyo mahāśambhu paprac yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā sahetyuktaṃ brahma kimasti kovā savaśvarādhi patiḥ nirguṇasaguṇābhyāṃ paraḥ kovā mūrttāmūrttābhyāmparaḥ kārtākāra yitāca kī dṛśaiti | atha kairmantraiḥ saṃsarā dvimucyajīvaḥ sadyo mukto bhavati kovā mantrāṇāmadhikāraṃ samanvetīti | mahovāca mahāśambhuḥ yatpṛṣṭa vāṃstasya‌ ca nāmarūpaṃ līlā'tha dhāmānitu cinmayāni manovaco gocarāṇyevaṃ tāni svayaṃ kṛpātaḥ sphuraṇaṃ prayānti ato rūpa manāmeti proktoyaṃ rāghavaḥ svarāṭ tana prakāśa bhūtañca yasya brahma sanātanam | sarvāvatāra līlāñca karoti saguṇoyaḥ‌ ayodhyāyāṃ svayaṃ rāmo rāsameva karoti saḥ saguṇa nirguṇābhyāṃ parasya paramapuruṣasya dāśarathermantrasya nāda vindu vāmmanaso‌ ragocarau tasyamantrāścānantāsteṣu ṣaṭśataṃ varīyāṃ sasteṣu ca trayoṃ mantrā atiśreṣṭhā | ṣaḍakṣaro dvayākhyaṃ mantra ratnaṃ yugma mantraśaceti vindu pūrvako dīrghāgnistataḥ kevalaṃ dīrghāgniḥ tato māyeti atha‌ prathanamaiti prathamaṃ śrīmaditi tatorāmacandra caraṇā viti brūyādanaṃtaraṃ śaraṇamiti padaṃ paścātprapadye iti vadet punaśca śrīmate iti atha rāmacandrayeti tadgre nama iti yo‌ dāśaratherdvayākhyaṃ mantrāṇāṃ pravaraṃ mantra ratnamadhīte sa‌ sarvān kāmānaśnute tena saha modate iti atha praṇavādanantaraṃ na dvitīyākṣarama stṛtīyā kṣaraṃ sī caturthākṣaraṃ tā pañcamākṣaraṃ ra ṣaṣṭhātaraṃ ma saptamākṣaraṃ bhyāmaṣṭamākṣara miti imamaṣṭākṣaraṃ vidvān mukto bhavati etanmantra trayaṃ sarva mantra varaṃ japtvā sadyo mucyate karma bandhanāt yaḥ śrīrāme'ti bhaktimān sa evaitanmantrādhikārīti | śrīrāma eva sarva kāraṇaṃ tasya rūpa dvayaṃ parichinna maparichinnaṃ parichinna svarūpeṇa sāketa pramodavane tiṣṭhan rāsa meva karoti dvitīyaṃ svarūpaṃ jagadupatyādeḥ kāraṇaṃ taddakṣiṇāṃgātkṣārābdhi śāyī vāmāṅgādramā vaikuṇṭhavāsīti hṛdayātpara nārāyaṇo vabhūva caraṇābhyāṃ vadariko pavana sthāyī śṛṅgārānnandanandana iti | evaṃ sarve'vatārāḥ śrīrāma candra caraṇa rekhābhyaḥ samudbhavanti tathā'nanta koṭi viṣṇvaśca caturvyūhaśca samudbhavanti evamaparājiteśvara maparimitāḥ paranārāyaṇādayaḥ aṣṭabhujā nārāyaṇāyaścānanta koṭi saṅkhyakāḥ vaddhāñjali puṭāḥ sarva kālaṃ samupāsate yadāviṣṇvādīna yadā'jñāpayati‌ tadā tad brahmāṇḍe sarva kāryaṃ kurvanti te sarve devādvividhāḥ bhinnāṃśā abhinnāṃśāśca śrīraghuvara mubhaye sevante bhinnāṃśā brahmādayaḥ abhinnāṃśā nārāṇādayaḥ| sahasraṃ samāḥ jīvātmanaḥ pañcāṅgopāsanāṃ kurvanti tata ānanda rūpā bhavanti tataḥ sadeva saumyeda magra āsīdeka mevā dvitīyaṃ sa ekṣata vahusyāṃ prajāyeya pūrvaṃ pañcāṅgopāsakāḥ sṛṣṭi samaye śrīkṛṣṇopāsanāṃ samanuṣṭhāya golokaṃ prāpnuvanti tatra kecittatraiva tiṣṭhanti kecidrāmopāsanā'dhikāriṇo bhavantīti viṣṇavādyuttamadehe praviṣṭo devatā'bhavat martyādadhama deheṣu sthito bhajati devatāḥ | parātparasya śrārāmanāmnaḥ sarveṣāṃ nārāyaṇādīnāṃ nāmāni bhavanti tasya dhāmnasteṣāṃ dhāmānyutpadyante tallīlātaḥ sarveṣāṃ līlā prādurbhavanti tatsvarūpātsarveṣāṃ rūpāṇyāvirbhavanti sa evāyo dhyādhipatiḥ sarva kāraṇānāmādi kāraṇaṃ na tasmātkiñcitparaṃ tatvamastīti | atha yantraṃ sama likhyate | rāma prāptai‌ mumukṣubhiḥ yantraṃ vinā na saṃsiddhi mantrāṇāṃ deva tātmanām | kāma krodhādi doṣāṇāṃ yantraṇāṃ ye na vaibhavet | tato yantra miti proktaṃ yamanādyantra mityapi | ṣaṭ koṇaṃ prathamaṃ lekhyaṃ vṛttaṃ saṃvilikhe ttataḥ | aṣṭau dalāni lekhyāni tatasyācca turasrakam | sarvaiśca lakṣaṇairyuktaṃ divyaṃ sarva‌ sukha pradam | sarvāvatāra vījaiśca veṣṭa yedyantra muta‌ mam | tataśca pūjanaṃ kuryādyaṃtra syaitasya sarvadā | tanmadhye vyakta mālekhyaṃ sādhya‌ karma vidhānataḥ| vījampunasta dvilikhettat kroḍī kṛtyamān matham | atha tatpañca vījānāmāvṛttiṃ vidadhītavai | bhūyo daśākṣareṇata dveṣṭayecchuddha buddhimān agnikoṇādi koṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni kramāllikhet |‌ punaḥ koṇakapoleṣu hīṃ śrīṃ ca vilikhetsudhīḥ | pratikoṇāgra mālekhyaṃ huṃ bījaṃ keśareṣvaca | varṇamālā manokhyātā catvāriṃśaca saptaca | varṇā sapta daleṣvevaṃ ṣaṭ ṣaṭ pañcāṣṭame dale | pūrvasyāddheṣṭayetkādi varṇaisarvaṃñcatatvavit | likhedvījadayaṃ samyak narasiṃha vārāhayoḥ | digvidukṣucapūrvasyāṃ bhūgṛhecaturastrakaiḥ | yantrametatsamārādhya bhuktiṃ muktiṃlabhennaraḥ | madhye'thavā likhettāraṃ ṣaṭ koṇedyapi‌ ca kramāt | varṇā śrīrāma mantrasya sandhiṣvagaṃ ca‌ mānmatham | gaṇḍeṣu ca tathā māyāṃ kiñjalke cā vilekhanam | pūrvavattatraparṇeṣu mālā mantra kramā llikhet | daśākṣareṇa saṃveṣdya kādīni vilikhettataḥ | digvidukṣu tathā vīje narasiṃhavārāhayoḥ yantrāntara midaṃ sāṅgaṃ māvaraṇaṃ vidhi‌nārcayet rājate vātha sauvarṇe bhūrje saṃlekhya pūjayet | huṃ jānakī vallabhāya svāhā kṣauṃr | huṃ paṭhetpunaḥ | daśākṣaro vārāhasya narasiṃhasya manuḥsmṛtaḥ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ tathonnamo vadettadanantaraṃ bhagavatepadaṃ brūyātiti raghunandanāyeti padaṃ vadet tato rakṣoghna viśadāyetica madhure na padaṃ paścāt prasanneti tato vadet vadanāyeti padaṃ brūyātpaścādamitatejaseiti tatobalāya nigadet rāmāya viṣṇave namaḥ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīñcoṃ namobhagavate raghunandanāya rakṣoghna viśadāya madhura prasanna vadanāya amita tejase balāya rāmāya viṣṇave namaḥ | eṣamālā manuḥ prokto nagaṇāṃ cintatārthadaḥ | oṃ sīṃ sītāyai vadan namontaḥ sītā mantra udāhṛtaḥ | mantre'smin rāmamārādhya sāṅga sāvaraṇaṃ tathā | ārādhya guṭikī kṛtya dhāraye dyantra manvaham | sarva duḥkha praśamanaṃ putra pautra pradaṃ nṛṇām | sarva vidyā pradaṃ śaśvat sarva saukhya karaṃ sadā | anyā bhicāra kṛtyeṣu vajra pañjara mevahi | kiṃ bahū ktyā nṛṇāma sarva siddhidaṃ śoka nāśakamiti || yantra samyak vidhānena dhārayetsādhakottamaḥ | śrīrāma dvāra pīṭhāgre parivāra tayā sthitān | gaṇeśādi surāna kṣetra pālānsarvānsa marcayet | svāntanu śodha yitvātaḥ paraṃ pūjana mācaret | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśa bhistathaikādaśabhiḥ sudhīḥ| pañcabhirvā yajeddevāna sva sva śaktya nukūlataḥ | sarva śakti yutaṃ rāmaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ japet | stūyātsarvān parivārān rāma prītyartha mādarāt | evaṃyaḥ kurute pūjāṃ yantra rājasya mānavaḥ iha kāmyaṃ sukhaṃ labdhvā pretya sāketamṛcchati | asya śrīrāma śaraṇāgata mantrasya śrī rāmacandro ṛṣidevī gāyatrī chandaḥ paramātmā śrīrāmacandro devatā rāṃ bījaṃ namaḥ śaktiḥ sarvā bhiṣṭārtha siddhaye jape viniyogaḥ mūle na kara śodhanaṃ kṛtvā prathamaṃ vījaṃ karatala karayornyaset | śeṣākṣarāṇyaṅguli parvasu vinyaset | śrīmadrāma candra caraṇau aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ śaraṇaṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ prapadye madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ śrīmate anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ rāmacandrāya kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ namaḥ karatalakara pṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ śrīrāmacandra caraṇau jñānāyahṛdayāya namaḥ śaraṇamaiśvaryyāya śirase svāhā prapadye śaktaye śipāyai vaṣaṭ śrīmate balāya kācāyahuṃ rāmacandrāya tejase netrābhyāṃ bauṣaṭ namo bījāya phaṭ śrīrāmacandracaraṇau jñānāya udarāya namaḥ śaraṇamaiśvaryyāya pṛṣṭhāya namaḥ prapadye śaktaye bāhubhyāṃ namaḥ śrīmate balāya ūrubhyāṃ namaḥ rāmacandrāya tejase jānubhyāṃ namaḥ namovīryyāya pādābhyāṃ namaḥ athadehanyāsaḥ śrīṃ namaḥ manamaḥ rāṃ namaḥ mannamaḥ cannamaḥ dranamaḥ caṃnamaḥ raṃnamaḥ ṇauṃ namaḥ śaṃnamaḥ raṃnamaḥ ṇaṃnamaḥ praṃnamaḥ paṃnamaḥ dyaṃnamaḥ śrīnamaḥ maṃnamaḥ namaḥ rāṃnamaḥ maṃnamaḥ caṃnamaḥ drāṃnamaḥ yaṃnamaḥ naṃnamaḥ moṃnamaḥ evamuparthya vinyaset śrīmmūddhinamatebhālerāmanetre candranāsikā yāṃ caraśrotre ṇau mukheśarabhujayoḥ ṇaṃhṛdiprapastanayoḥ dyenābhau śrīpṛṣṭhematejaṅghayoḥ rāmakaṭyāṃ candrā ūrvoḥ ya jānuni namaḥ pādayeḥ athadhyānam | jānakī sahitaṃ rāmamindra nīla maṇi prabham | jñāna mudrā gharaṃ sarva bhūṣābhiḥ samalaṃ kṛtam || pārśvanyasta dhanurvāṇaṃ sarvācayava sundaram | rājīvalocanaṃ dhyāyetsarvā bhiṣṭārtha siddhaye || oṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ namaḥ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ sītā rāmābhyāṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ anā‌mikābhyāṃ namaḥ namaḥ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ sītārāmobhyāṃ karatala kara pābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ jñānāyahṛdayāya namaḥ namaḥ aiśvaryāya śirase svāhā sītārāmobhyāṃ śaktaye śikhāyai vaṣaṭ oṃ balāya kava cāpahunnamastejase netrābhyāṃ sītārāmobhyāṃ vīryyāya astrāya phaṭ dhyānaṃ pūrvavat | asya rāmaṣaḍakṣara mantrarājasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ gāyatrī chandaḥ śrī rāmo devatā rāṃ bījaṃ namaḥ śaktiḥ rāmāyeti kīlakaṃ śrī rāma prītyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | oṃ brahmaṇe ṛṣayenamaḥ śiraśi oṃ‌ gāyatrī chandase namo mukhe oṃ rāṃ devatāyai namo‌ hṛdi oṃ rāṃ bījāyanamoguhye oṃ namaḥ śaktaye namaḥ pādayo; oṃ rāmāya kīlakāya namaḥ sarvāṅge oṃ rāṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ rīṃ tarjanībhyāṃsvāhā oṃ rūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ oṃ raiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ huṃ oṃ rauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ oṃ ra; karatala rāṃ namaḥ śirasi rāmāya namaḥ nābhau namo namaḥ pādayoḥ | deha śuddhiṃ vidhāyādau pūjayedraghunandanam | pūjā dravyāṇi saṃśodhya pūjāpātrāṇiśodhayet || dravyai suprokṣatai samyak pūjayet puruṣottamam | vidhinārādhito rāmaḥ samyagārādhitobhavet | mandiraṃ mārjayitvātha devamāvāhayedvibhum | āvāhayitvā deveśaṃ madhye pādyaṃ tathā'rpayet || madhuparkaṃ tato dadyāttatastvāca mayedvibhum | sarayvādi salilairdevaṃ snāpayetsītayāmaha || vastrāṇi dhāpayetsamyak yajña sūtrañcadhā‌ payet | aṅga rāgaṃ samapryātha tulasī puṣpamālikā |‌ samarpayettataḥ sarva bhūṣaṇairbhuṣaye dvibhum | aṅgāṇi pūjayetsamyak tato rāmaḥ prasīdati || dhūpaṃ dīpañca naivedya mārartika mathāpryayet | puṣpāñjali matho dadyātparikramaṇa mevaca || praṇamet śāstra vidhinā stūyāstotrai parātparam | evaṃ sampūjayedyastu‌ so'mṛtatvañca gacchati || idantu paramaṃ guhyaṃ rahasyaṃ sarva durlabham | rāmabhaktāya dātavyaṃ na deyamprākṛtāyeceti || ityatharvaṇe viśvambharopaniṣat samāptaḥ ||
